desc: Ideation / derive formula: answer = min(D, K // F), where D = BFS distance 1→N and F = max edge-disjoint paths in the layered forward-DAG (unit-capacity max flow). Verified by upper-bound argument (F disjoint paths, each flipped edge on ≤1 of them ⇒ distance ≤ K/F; distance ≤ D) and achievability via Mengerian d-cover (d·F edges suffice to hit every path ≥ d times).
Implement solve(): read N, M, K and edges from stdin with fast I/O.
BFS from vertex 1 to compute dist[] layers; D = dist[N].
Build Dinic flow network: source=1, sink=N; add each edge (u,v) with capacity 1 iff dist[v]==dist[u]+1 (parallel edges each get capacity 1).
Run Dinic to compute F; answer = min(D, K // F); print answer.
Verify on samples: (1) →1, (2) →2, (3) →0; edge cases (multi-edges, K > D·F, unreachable vertices, recursion depth) all checked.
